results.budget_covers: media and programme spend only, excluding salaries and tools

review.summary: To meet its share, marketing must source £1,200,000 of the £2,000,000 revenue target, which means creating £4,800,000 of pipeline across 192 opportunities a year. With a marketing budget of £298,667 a year, equal to 24.9% of the revenue it sources, the plan is workable and realistic, provided the conversion rates hold.
review.constraint: The biggest constraint is lead volume, as the plan needs 2,667 leads a year, and at an average cost per lead of £112 the budget leaves little margin for higher costs.
risks: Sales must turn 25% of opportunities into won deals, and any shortfall there would reduce the 48 won deals a year the plan depends on.
Events leads cost £250 each, well above the average cost per lead of £112, so leaning on that channel would push spend up quickly.
actions: Ask Sales to lift opportunity to won from 25% to 30%, which would save £49,778 of budget, as Sales controls this stage.
Focus marketing effort on lead to MQL, which marketing controls, and test moving it from 30% to 35%, a change worth £42,667.
Review the £100,000 Events budget, since Events leads cost £250 each against an average of £112, and a tenth lower cost per lead across all channels would save £29,867 a year.
